name: Power Players: Defenders 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames

description: Power Players: Defenders is a match-3 arcade game where you must assist Axel in his one-on-one combat against the invaders by employing your match-3 abilities. Madcap is attempting to seize control of the city using a vast number of evil toys, and it's your responsibility to put an end to his plan!
